_README: The professional profile, taken from the LinkedIn PDF export. There is no /cv/ page: this feeds the homepage, the hero role and location, the What I do section, and the Studied / Awarded / Speaks / Certified rows under About. Every block renders only when it has content. `points` is empty on every role because the export carries no bullets: add two or three per role and they appear. The Axon and FPT dates overlap on purpose, those roles ran concurrently.
name: Sinh Le Dinh
headline: Data Plumber
summary: I'm a data engineer who likes owning the whole path from raw data to something people actually trust and use. For the past few years I've been building a healthcare analytics platform on Azure, with Databricks, Delta Lake, and dbt at the core and Azure DevOps for CI/CD. Day to day that means designing incremental pipelines and writing models that are tested and documented. I work closely with PMs and tech leads to turn loose requirements into maintainable models. Open to Data Engineer / Analytics Engineer roles where the modern data stack and governance both matter.
